fullText.simplified:
第三章、密室

    石文谦在观察洞窟的情况，没有听到简西后面的话。
    “喂！你在想什么呢？我在跟你说话呢，你听到了吗？”简西拍了拍石文谦的肩膀。
    “不好意思，你刚说什么？”石文谦看了一眼简西。
    “我问你的名字，你怎么在这里，是不是莫高窟的研究员。”简西重复着她的问题。
    “石文谦，刚来的研究员，我来特窟查看现场。你刚才往里面走了吗？洞窟里面有什么？”石文谦快速回答完简西，提出了自己的问题。
    “那边有一个通道，很窄，我……我还没往里走，一起过去看看吧。”简西说道。
    他们两个人来到了通道前，这里确实很狭窄，每次只能通过一个人。简西走在了前面，石文谦并没有着急进入通道，他用手电筒的光照了照通道口，这里似乎原本是一扇暗门，难道说这儿附近有机关，打开了这条通道的暗门？
    “石文谦，你跟上了吗？”简西回头问道。
    “来了来了。”石文谦侧着身子挤进了通道，跟着简西向前面走去，他边走边问：“你来的时候，这儿就已经有这条通道了吗？”
    “是……是啊，我刚看见这条路，就不小心摔倒了，这不就遇见你了嘛。”简西犹豫了一下，回答道。
    石文谦和简西来到了一个小密室，这里只有五六平方米的样子。密室的墙壁上画着一些图案。图案正中间有一朵莲花，莲花上方有一颗圆形的宝珠。莲花的两侧有两个人，但是他们的下半身都有一条长长的尾巴。
    “这两个人是谁？”简西晃了晃手电筒，用光源指向墙壁。
    石文谦仔细地看着，观察了一会儿，说：“这应该是中国古代神话中创造人类的神——伏羲和女娲。男神是伏羲，女神是女娲。他们都是人面蛇身。”
    “这也是隋朝的壁画吗？外面那个窟是隋朝时期的佛教轮回转世图，对吧？但我觉得这个画风和外面的相差很多。”简西说道。
    “这的确不是隋代的，从线条和颜色上来看，至少要比隋代早上一两百年。”石文谦回答道。
    “同一个窟内出现不同朝代的壁画，这合理吗？”简西似乎对这一切充满了好奇。
    “这确实很有意思。一般来说，一个窟里的塑像和壁画风格是统一的。外面是隋代的壁画，里面也应该是隋代的。但是这里似乎是一个密室，你刚才注意到通道的入口了吗？那儿似乎有一扇暗门，不知道怎么的被打开了。我看过316号特窟的资料，并没有现在这个密室。”
fullText.traditional:
第三章、密室

    石文謙在觀察洞窟的情況，沒有聽到簡西後面的話。
    “喂！你在想什麼呢？我在跟你說話呢，你聽到了嗎？”簡西拍了拍石文謙的肩膀。
    “不好意思，你剛說什麼？”石文謙看了一眼簡西。
    “我問你的名字，你怎麼在這裡，是不是莫高窟的研究員。”簡西重複著她的問題。
    “石文謙，剛來的研究員，我來特窟查看現場。你剛才往裡面走了嗎？洞窟裡面有什麼？”石文謙快速回答完簡西，提出了自己的問題。
    “那邊有一個通道，很窄，我……我還沒往裡走，一起過去看看吧。”簡西說道。
    他們兩個人來到了通道前，這裡確實很狹窄，每次只能通過一個人。簡西走在了前面，石文謙並沒有著急進入通道，他用手電筒的光照了照通道口，這裡似乎原本是一扇暗門，難道說這兒附近有機關，打開了這條通道的暗門？
    “石文謙，你跟上了嗎？”簡西回頭問道。
    “來了來了。”石文謙側著身子擠進了通道，跟著簡西向前面走去，他邊走邊問：“你來的時候，這兒就已經有這條通道了嗎？”
    “是……是啊，我剛看見這條路，就不小心摔倒了，這不就遇見你了嘛。”簡西猶豫了一下，回答道。
    石文謙和簡西來到了一個小密室，這裡只有五六平方米的樣子。密室的牆壁上畫著一些圖案。圖案正中間有一朵蓮花，蓮花上方有一顆圓形的寶珠。蓮花的兩側有兩個人，但是他們的下半身都有一條長長的尾巴。
    “這兩個人是誰？”簡西晃了晃手電筒，用光源指向牆壁。
    石文謙仔細地看著，觀察了一會兒，說：“這應該是中國古代神話中創造人類的神——伏羲和女媧。男神是伏羲，女神是女媧。他們都是人面蛇身。”
    “這也是隋朝的壁畫嗎？外面那個窟是隋朝時期的佛教輪迴轉世圖，對吧？但我覺得這個畫風和外面的相差很多。”簡西說道。
    “這的確不是隋代的，從線條和顏色上來看，至少要比隋代早上一兩百年。”石文謙回答道。
    “同一個窟內出現不同朝代的壁畫，這合理嗎？”簡西似乎對這一切充滿了好奇。
    “這確實很有意思。一般來說，一個窟裡的塑像和壁畫風格是統一的。外面是隋代的壁畫，裡面也應該是隋代的。但是這裡似乎是一個密室，你剛才注意到通道的入口了嗎？那兒似乎有一扇暗門，不知道怎么的被打開了。我看過316號特窟的資料，並沒有現在這個密室。”

sentences.pinyin: jiǎn xī sì hū duì zhè yí qiè chōng mǎn le hào qí
sentences.english: Jian Xi seemed to be full of curiosity about everything there.

sentences.simplified: “这确实很有意思。一般来说，一个窟里的塑像和壁画风格是统一的。
sentences.traditional: “這確實很有意思。一般來說，一個窟裡的塑像和壁畫風格是統一的。
sentences.pinyin: zhè què shí hěn yǒu yì si yì bān lái shuō yí ge kū lǐ de sù xiàng hé bì huà fēng gé shì tǒng yī de
sentences.english: “This is indeed very interesting. Generally speaking, the style of statues and murals in a cave are the same.

sentences.simplified: 外面是隋代的壁画，里面也应该是隋代的。
sentences.traditional: 外面是隋代的壁畫，裡面也應該是隋代的。
sentences.pinyin: wài miàn shì suí dài de bì huà lǐ miàn yě yīng gāi shì suí dài de
sentences.english: The murals outside are from the Sui Dynasty, so the ones inside should be from the Sui Dynasty as well.

sentences.simplified: 但是这里似乎是一个密室，你刚才注意到通道的入口了吗？
sentences.traditional: 但是這裡似乎是一個密室，你剛才注意到通道的入口了嗎？
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì zhè lǐ sì hū shì yí ge mì shì nǐ gāng cái zhù yì dào tōng dào de rù kǒu le ma
sentences.english: But this seems to be a secret chamber. Did you notice the entrance to the passage just now?

sentences.simplified: 那儿似乎有一扇暗门，不知道怎么的被打开了。
sentences.traditional: 那兒似乎有一扇暗門，不知道怎么的被打開了。
sentences.pinyin: nà'r sì hū yǒu yí shàn àn mén bù zhī dào zěn me de bèi dǎ kāi le
sentences.english: There seems to be a hidden door there, and somehow it got opened.

sentences.simplified: 我看过316号特窟的资料，并没有现在这个密室。”
sentences.traditional: 我看過316號特窟的資料，並沒有現在這個密室。”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ kàn guò 5 hào tè kū de zī liào bìng méi yǒu xiàn zài zhè ge mì shì
sentences.english: I have looked at information about Special Cave No. 316, and there was no secret chamber like this one now.”

sentence_translations: Chapter 3: The Secret Chamber
Shi Wenqian was observing the situation in the cave and did not hear what Jian Xi said behind him.
“Hey! What are you thinking about? I am talking to you. Did you hear me?” Jian Xi patted Shi Wenqian on the shoulder.
“I’m sorry, what did you just say?” Shi Wenqian glanced at Jian Xi.
“I asked your name, why you’re here, and whether you are a researcher at the Mogao Caves.” Jian Xi repeated her questions.
“Shi Wenqian, newly arrived researcher. I am here to inspect the site of the special caves.
Did you go inside just now? What is inside the cave?” After quickly answering Jian Xi, Shi Wenqian asked his own questions.
“There is a passage over there. It’s very narrow. I … I haven’t gone in yet. Let’s go and take a look together,” Jian Xi said.
The two of them arrived at the passage. It was indeed very narrow, only allowing one person to pass at a time.
Jian Xi walked ahead. Shi Wenqian was not in a rush to enter the passage.
He shone the flashlight at the entrance of the passage, and it seemed that there was originally a hidden door here.
Could it really be that there was a mechanism nearby that opened the hidden door in the passage?
“Shi Wenqian, have you caught up?” Jian Xi turned around and asked.
“Coming, coming.” Shi Wenqian squeezed sideways into the passage and followed Jian Xi forward.
As he walked, he asked, “When you got here, was this passage already there?”
“Yes … yes, I had just seen this path when I accidentally fell. And that’s when I came across you.”
Jian Xi replied after hesitating for a moment.
Shi Wenqian and Jian Xi arrived at a small secret chamber, which seemed like it was only about five or six square meters.
There were some patterns drawn on the walls of the secret chamber.
There was a lotus flower in the middle of the pattern, and there was a round pearl above the lotus flower.
There were two people on either side of the lotus, but both of them had long tails on the lower halves of their bodies.
“Who are these two people?” Jian Xi shook the flashlight, using the light to point at the wall.
Shi Wenqian looked carefully, observed for a while, and said, ..
.. “This looks like Fuxi and Nüwa, the gods who created mankind in ancient Chinese mythology.
The male god is Fuxi, and the female god is Nüwa. They both have human faces and snake bodies.”
“Is this also a mural from the Sui Dynasty?
That cave outside is a Buddhist reincarnation mural from the Sui Dynasty period, right?
“But I think the style of this painting is very different from the one outside,” Jian Xi said.
“This is indeed not from the Sui Dynasty.
Judging from the lines and colors, it is at least one to two hundred years earlier than the Sui Dynasty,” Shi Wenqian replied.
“Does it make sense for murals from different dynasties to appear in the same cave?”
Jian Xi seemed to be full of curiosity about everything there.
“This is indeed very interesting. Generally speaking, the style of statues and murals in a cave are the same.
The murals outside are from the Sui Dynasty, so the ones inside should be from the Sui Dynasty as well.
But this seems to be a secret chamber. Did you notice the entrance to the passage just now?
There seems to be a hidden door there, and somehow it got opened.
I have looked at information about Special Cave No. 316, and there was no secret chamber like this one now.”
